flavor: A vast, hollowed-out cavern where the walls are composed of translucent, deep-blue ice. Suspended within the frozen ceiling are hundreds of perfectly preserved, unmoving figures, their faces caught in expressions of eternal stillness.
name: The Permafrost Ossuary
reason: The room serves as a macabre gallery of ancient travelers, frozen mid-stride and preserved by the unnatural cold, offering a moment of eerie stillness and historical contemplation.
